organization_ai_provider_policy_approval.name: organization_ai_provider_policy_approval_fields_check
organization_ai_provider_policy_approval.value: ("organization_ai_provider_policy"."status" = 'draft') or ("organization_ai_provider_policy"."approved_by" is not null and "organization_ai_provider_policy"."approved_at" is not null and "organization_ai_provider_policy"."approval_note" is not null)

project_client_type_check.name: project_client_type_check
project_client_type_check.value: (("project"."type" = 'client' and "project"."client_id" is not null) or ("project"."type" = 'internal' and "project"."client_id" is null))

project_membership_role_check.name: project_membership_role_check
project_membership_role_check.value: "role" in ('Admin', 'Project Owner', 'Architect / Tech Lead', 'Business Analyst / Coordinator', 'Developer', 'QA', 'Client Viewer / Approver')

requirement_analysis_run_mode_lineage_ch.name: requirement_analysis_run_mode_lineage_check
requirement_analysis_run_mode_lineage_ch.value:
("requirement_analysis_run"."mode" = 'fresh' and "requirement_analysis_run"."replay_of_run_id" is null and "requirement_analysis_run"."reprocess_of_run_id" is null and "requirement_analysis_run"."retry_of_run_id" is null)
        or ("requirement_analysis_run"."mode" = 'replay' and "requirement_analysis_run"."replay_of_run_id" is not null and "requirement_analysis_run"."reprocess_of_run_id" is null and "requirement_analysis_run"."retry_of_run_id" is null)
        or ("requirement_analysis_run"."mode" = 'reprocess' and "requirement_analysis_run"."reprocess_of_run_id" is not null and "requirement_analysis_run"."replay_of_run_id" is null and "requirement_analysis_run"."retry_of_run_id" is null)
        or ("requirement_analysis_run"."mode" = 'retry' and "requirement_analysis_run"."retry_of_run_id" is not null and "requirement_analysis_run"."replay_of_run_id" is null and "requirement_analysis_run"."reprocess_of_run_id" is null)

requirement_analysis_run_cancel_fields_c.name: requirement_analysis_run_cancel_fields_check
requirement_analysis_run_cancel_fields_c.value: ("requirement_analysis_run"."cancel_requested_at" is null and "requirement_analysis_run"."cancel_requested_by" is null) or ("requirement_analysis_run"."cancel_requested_at" is not null and "requirement_analysis_run"."cancel_requested_by" is not null)

requirement_analysis_run_failure_fields_.name: requirement_analysis_run_failure_fields_check
requirement_analysis_run_failure_fields_.value: ("requirement_analysis_run"."status" <> 'failed') or ("requirement_analysis_run"."failure_code" is not null and "requirement_analysis_run"."failure_retryable" is not null)

source_document_document_format_presence.name: source_document_document_format_presence_check
source_document_document_format_presence.value: (("source_document"."source_type" = 'document' and "source_document"."document_format" is not null) or ("source_document"."source_type" <> 'document' and "source_document"."document_format" is null))
